item.title: Dreamy Neutral Living Room Styling Ideas for a Cozy Home
item.description: Transform your space with a cozy neutral living room featuring a plush cloud sofa and warm textures. 1. Colors: Stick to a calming palette of warm whites, beige, and soft greys. 2. Lighting: Layer ambient floor lamps and warm fairy lights. 3. Textures: Mix boucle, knit throws, and natural wood. #HomeDecor #CozyHome #LivingRoomDecor #InteriorDesignIdeas #ApartmentTherapy
